thread:
Jane.support: @miguel @anna escalating — Acme hit another intermittent SSE failure after token rotation. They see partial output, then an empty data frame, client iterator returns and they reopen the stream leading to duplicate billing. trace-id: trace-ACME-20260314-91. SDKs impacted: ts-sdk v2.4.0, python-sdk v1.9.6. Started 2026-03-14 09:12UTC.

Miguel.eng: can you paste minimal repro steps and a small log snippet? also need connection id if available.

Jane.support: repro steps from customer (simplified):
```bash
# open SSE stream with old token
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OLD' -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -d 'prompt=hi'
# while stream open they trigger a token refresh on their side (rotate call to auth service)
# client SDK receives a new token and attempts reconnect/resume
```
They supplied this server-side log (redacted):
[2026-03-14T09:12:04Z] conn=abcd1234 stream chunk: data: {\"delta\":\"hello\"}
[2026-03-14T09:12:05Z] conn=abcd1234 token_rotate: old->new
[2026-03-14T09:12:05Z] conn=abcd1234 stream chunk: data:
[2026-03-14T09:12:05Z] conn=abcd1234 stream closed client: EOF

Anna.sre: that empty "data:" frame at the time of token_rotate looks suspicious — client libs sometimes treat an empty data line as final. which SDK is seeing the iterator close?

Jane.support: both TS and Python clients. customer says TS iterator resolves early (no more events) and then they call the API again to resume which creates the duplicate billing window.

Liam.devex: quick check — we merged an eventsource polyfill bump in ts-sdk v2.4.0 (PR #414). polyfill changed handling for heartbeat/empty-data frames. could be regression.

Miguel.eng: i can reproduce locally with a small node repro. minimal ts snippet:
```js
const es = new EventSource(url, {headers:{Authorization: 'Bearer '+OLD}})
es.onmessage = (m) => { if (!m.data) { console.log('empty data -> interpreted as final?'); } else { console.log('data', m.data); } }
// then rotate old -> new server-side during stream
```
When server sends an empty data frame exactly on token rotation, the iterator ends.

Anna.sre: server-side quick inspection — why are we sending an empty data line on rotate? is it a heartbeat or a flush marker?

Miguel.eng: digging through runtime — rotation code had a short path that calls stream.flush() which emits a newline-only data frame to mark flush. That used to be harmless because SDKs ignored pure-newline frames; polyfill change made eventsource treat it as a message with empty data.

Liam.devex: root cause found: eventsource polyfill PR changed empty-data semantics. reproduces across node/browser runtimes.

Jane.support: customer asking for a hotfix/mitigation — any immediate workaround we can offer?

Miguel.eng: short term: server can avoid emitting a bare newline on rotate — i will patch runtime to drop empty data frames in the rotate path. also add server flag to emit 'event: keep-alive' instead of 'data:\n'.

Anna.sre: i'll canary the server patch to us-west (low-risk) and monitor for duplicate-resume incidents.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime/rotate-empty-frame-fix -> canary/us-west. watching metrics: sse.disconnects, sse.duplicate-resume, error-rate.

Liam.devex: additionally we should harden SDKs: treat empty-string m.data as a heartbeat and ignore (do not resolve iterator). i'll open PRs: ts-sdk #430 to ignore empty message bodies; python-sdk #212 to same.

Miguel.eng: assigning myself for server fix and the TS SDK follow-up. anna will own rollout monitoring. liam will own SDK PRs and test matrix (node v14/16/18, browsers). jane pls coordinate customer comms and advise temporary workaround: disable client-side token auto-rotate or stagger rotation to off-peak while we roll fix.

Jane.support: forwarding plan to customer and asking them to test disabling rotation. will post back results. thanks team. :pray:

Anna.sre: canary healthy after 12min, metrics for duplicate-resume down to zero in canary region. deploy-bot: Canary successful -> promote?

Miguel.eng: promote please, patch ready and unit tested.

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> rollout to prod in batches. will notify when done.

Liam.devex: opened ts-sdk PR (#430) and added regression unit that simulates empty-data frames; marking for v2.4.1 patch.

Jane.support: customer confirmed workaround worked (disabled token auto-rotate) and will move to test prod once patch lands. closing ESC until post-rollout verification.

Miguel.eng: postmortem notes: regression introduced by eventsource polyfill change; fixes: (1) server: avoid emitting newline-only data frames on rotate, (2) SDKs: ignore empty data messages. add integration test that simulates midstream token rotate.

Jane.support: note to self: update KB article with 'sse token rotate' FAQs and the temporary mitigation.
